shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package-lock.json | head -30 && node -v && npm -v

cat package.json index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "--- $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "router|gravity"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

rm -rf dist && sed -i "s/import { Button, Switch, Text, ThemeProvider }/import { Button, Switch, ThemeProvider }/" src/App.tsx && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/; s#<title>.*</title>#<title>Мини-приложение</title>#' index.html && npx tsc --noEmit && echo OK
